items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Bobby YsiquirrE is the one that I told the story about, that John Kirby took his place.

ctx.x: This is reported in the International Musician in May of '31. There's also a person's name in quotes here -- Clarence -- I can't even read it. Looks like Ysiquirre. Siquirri or something.
